approval: AGENTS.md 授權代理在 benchmark 改版時依證據跟隨新版、舊版保留為證據。2026-11-26 每日查核發現 Vals 已把 Vibe Code Bench v1.1 封存並以 v1.1.1 取代，代理依此規則改用 v1.1.1。

reviews.reason: The Vals v1.1 page is labelled 'Archived Benchmark' and states 'Vibe Code Bench v1.1 has been superseded by v1.1.1.' v1.1.1 (released 2026-11-23) keeps the tasks and specifications, but re-grades each model's v1.1 builds with an upgraded browser-testing agent, a second judge for failed checks, a 100% substep pass bar (was 90%) and fixed or removed ambiguous UI steps. Scores drop across the board (51/51 overlapping rows lower by 0.7-25.7 points), so the versions are not interchangeable; v1.1 rows are retained only as evidence and the same applications count once.
